modelObjects.name: Agent Governance
modelObjects.description: Advisory agent governance landscape: two PR review agents (NorthStarGuardian and PRAgent) that comment on pull requests without blocking merge, plus a cross-project agent learning corpus that distills session transcripts into promoted skills and ADRs. The shared posture is advisory-only, repo-native state, and transcripts as ground truth.
modelObjects.caption: advisory agent governance

modelObjects.name: Developer
modelObjects.description: Human author of pull requests and the merge authority. Opens PRs, issues slash commands (/init-guardian, /amend, /chronicle, /status), reads advisory comments, and runs /retrospective to capture learnings. Retains final merge decisions; the agents only advise.
modelObjects.caption: human merge authority

modelObjects.name: AI Agents
modelObjects.description: The advisory review agents (Guardian interview agent, PRAgent role agents) plus the broader Cursor / Codex / Claude Code coding agents that do implementation work and produce session transcripts. They are themselves governed by the advisory PR agents and feed transcripts into the learning corpus.
modelObjects.caption: advisory + coding agents

modelObjects.name: NorthStarGuardian
modelObjects.description: An advisory GitHub Action that watches a repository for drift from its declared North Star. Runs on pull requests, reads a pinned base-branch North Star snapshot, evaluates the PR against ranked principles and anti-patterns, and posts a structured interview back to the PR. Guardian-owned state is repo-native under .github/guardian/. Pre-alpha; the core pipeline is covered by tests against synthetic PR fixtures.
modelObjects.caption: North Star drift reviewer

modelObjects.name: Guardian PR Trigger & Runner
modelObjects.description: GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/guardian.yml) that runs `guardian interview` on pull_request opened/synchronize/reopened events and `guardian command` on issue_comment slash commands. Orchestrates the interview pipeline: checkout, Python setup, North Star load, interview generation, and comment posting. Skips gracefully when OPENAI_API_KEY is absent.
modelObjects.caption: guardian CLI on Actions

modelObjects.name: North Star Reader
modelObjects.description: Parses the Markdown + YAML-frontmatter North Star (guardian/north_star.py). For PR review, reads docs/northstar.md from the base SHA via `git show` so a PR cannot evaluate itself against modified rules. When source=linear, delegates to Linear integration. Writes the active copy and snapshot metadata under .github/guardian/.
modelObjects.caption: pinned policy loader

modelObjects.name: Interview Generator
modelObjects.description: Runs the OpenAI-backed semantic review prompts (intent, alignment, anti-pattern, chronicle) over the PR diff and pinned North Star (guardian/analyze.py, chronicle.py). Produces the interview report: alignment summary, principle verdicts, saga assignment, suggestions, and chronicle paragraph. Uses openai_model_analysis (default gpt-5).
modelObjects.caption: OpenAI semantic review

modelObjects.name: Guardian Memory Manager
modelObjects.description: Owns Guardian-owned state under .github/guardian/memory/ (guardian/memory.py, governance.py, chronicle.py, dashboard.py). Persists journal entries, saga assignments, drift-ledger entries, debt-timers for declared variances, the northstar-snapshot, and regenerates dashboard.html. Treats the .github/guardian tree as a tracked local state root with read/write/exists/list/json helpers.
modelObjects.caption: repo-native memory writer

modelObjects.name: Linear Integration
modelObjects.description: Optional managed policy and follow-up surface (guardian/linear.py). When north_star.source=linear, fetches the configured Linear document via GraphQL, normalizes and SHA-256 hashes it, and writes it to the active copy with snapshot metadata. Creates Linear follow-up issues for policy amendment proposals and drift tasks. Linear may be canonical, but the exact snapshot is always recorded.
modelObjects.caption: optional Linear policy

modelObjects.name: Guardian PR Commenter
modelObjects.description: Posts the structured interview report as a PR comment and handles slash-command responses (guardian/github_io.py). Uses the GITHUB_TOKEN with pull-requests:write and issues:write. Comments are advisory; enable_blocking_escalation defaults to false so drift records never become hard merge blocks unless explicitly opted in.
modelObjects.caption: interview comment poster

modelObjects.name: North Star Policy Docs
modelObjects.description: Tracked repo content holding the human-facing North Star at docs/northstar.md (identity, ranked principles, approved architecture, anti-patterns) and the Guardian active copy / snapshot at .github/guardian/northstar.md. PR review reads the base-branch version so the policy used to evaluate a PR is pinned and immutable for that review.
modelObjects.caption: docs/northstar.md

modelObjects.name: Guardian Memory
modelObjects.description: Repo-native Guardian state under .github/guardian/memory/: northstar-snapshot.json, amendment-log.md, journal/, sagas/_index.json, drift-ledger.json, debt-timers.json, and dashboard.html. Tracked Git content, not hidden local state or a separate branch, so drift and variance are inspectable in a normal checkout and reviewable in PRs.
modelObjects.caption: .github/guardian/memory

modelObjects.name: PRAgent
modelObjects.description: A Letta-centered advisory PR review system with multiple bounded role agents and no multi-agent orchestration. A deterministic runner invokes dependency triage, architecture alternatives, synthesis, and evaluator agents in order, passing file artifacts. Comments on every PR with dependency/version/security triage and exactly five architecture alternatives, while never modifying code or blocking merges. Project skeleton with real validators and evidence scripts; not yet connected to a live Letta agent or GitHub App installation.
modelObjects.caption: Letta advisory reviewer

modelObjects.name: PR Orchestrator & Webhook Worker
modelObjects.description: Starts a review run from PR opened/synchronize/reopened events. Day-one path uses the Letta Code GitHub Action; production path is a GitHub App webhook worker (runtime/github_app/webhook_worker.py) backed by deploy/k8s webhook-worker + agent-worker deployments. The orchestrator does not reason: it creates a review run, invokes the evidence builder and agents, and posts or updates one comment. Prevents duplicate runs for the same PR SHA.
modelObjects.caption: webhook + Actions trigger

modelObjects.name: Evidence Builder
modelObjects.description: Turns a PR and checkout into a bounded .agent-review-inputs/ bundle the agents read: metadata.json, pr-diff.patch, changed-files.txt, repo-map.md, dependency-inventory.json, scanner outputs, prior-memory.json, and comment-template.md (scripts/build_evidence_bundle.py). Separates deterministic evidence from LLM reasoning; the bundle can be archived for evaluator replay.
modelObjects.caption: .agent-review-inputs bundle

modelObjects.name: Tools Layer
modelObjects.description: Mature scanners that produce evidence, not advice: Renovate dry-run (dependency extraction + update lookup), OSV-Scanner (known vulnerabilities, JSON), optional OWASP Dependency-Check (deeper SCA / SARIF), Context7 (current library docs), and dep_check.py as a normalizer/fallback (scripts/normalize_renovate.py, normalize_osv.py, discover_dependencies.py). Scanners never create dependency PRs in this flow.
modelObjects.caption: Renovate/OSV/OWASP/Context7

modelObjects.name: Dependency Triage Agent
modelObjects.description: Bounded Letta role agent that turns dependency evidence into useful X/Y advisory findings (system/dependency-agent-instructions.md, runtime/letta/agents/dependency-advisory-agent.md). Emits dependency-findings.json and dependency-section.md as auditable artifacts. Does not query package registries directly; reasons over scanner output and PR context.
modelObjects.caption: dependency triage role

modelObjects.name: Architecture Alternatives Agent
modelObjects.description: Bounded Letta role agent that reads the diff and surrounding code and produces exactly five repo-grounded architecture alternatives, each with pros, cons, and when to switch (system/architecture-agent-instructions.md). Generic boilerplate counts as a failed review. Emits architecture-findings.json and architecture-section.md; uses Context7 doc notes when alternatives depend on current APIs.
modelObjects.caption: exactly five alternatives

modelObjects.name: Advisory Synthesis Agent
modelObjects.description: Bounded Letta role agent and the only stage with PR-comment write permission (system/synthesis-agent-instructions.md, runtime/letta/agents/comment-synthesis-agent.md). Composes one readable final advisory comment from validated dependency and architecture artifacts, states the evidence used, and writes a structured review-record.json for future recall.
modelObjects.caption: single comment writer

modelObjects.name: Evaluator Agent
modelObjects.description: Separate periodic loop that grades whether the advisory agents hit the requirements and what they miss (system/evaluator-instructions.md, evaluation-rubric.md, scripts/run_evaluator.py, .github/workflows/evaluator.yml). Scores predicted usefulness against observed outcomes and converts raw review history into durable lessons that feed future reviews. Evaluation is separate from review.
modelObjects.caption: periodic calibration loop

modelObjects.name: Validators & Advisory Enforcement
modelObjects.description: Deterministic quality gates and advisory-only enforcement (validators/ + runtime/letta/hooks/deny_mutation.py): dependency X/Y validation, exactly-five/specificity validation, and the comment-contract validator. Enforces advisory-only at multiple layers: GitHub token/app permissions, Letta tool allowlist/denylist, permission mode, PreToolUse hooks, output validator, and no repo write token in the agent environment.
modelObjects.caption: deny_mutation + contracts

modelObjects.name: Letta Memory & Review Records
modelObjects.description: Letta durable memory (core, archival, MemFS) plus memfs/review-agent scaffolding for evaluator lessons and review-record.json per run. Memory is scoped by repository and by role to avoid mixing dependency, architecture, and evaluator lessons into one vague pool. Sleep-time / scheduled consolidation converts raw review records into reusable lessons; memory is tied to repo outcomes, not chat summaries.
modelObjects.caption: Letta core/archival/MemFS

modelObjects.name: Agent Learning Corpus
modelObjects.description: agent-control-plane: a cross-project store for agent session learnings. Not a project authority repo and not a runtime app; it holds distilled learnings with links back to transcript IDs. Layout: sessions/ (dated write-ups grouped by project), catalog/ (cross-session themes), promotion-queue/ (pending -> resolved -> promoted), capture/scratch/ (raw reconstruction), tools/ (optional scanners). Learning IDs use LRN-YYYYMMDD-NNN.
modelObjects.caption: agent-control-plane

modelObjects.name: Corpus Markdown
modelObjects.description: The distilled markdown corpus: session summaries with transcript paths, catalog theme indexes (e.g. verify-before-claim, multi-agent-coordination, secrets-and-doppler), the promotion queue, and scratch reconstruction notes. Authority order: transcripts on disk are ground truth; this repo holds distilled learnings; frozenSkillz holds promoted procedures; project repos hold product facts only.
modelObjects.caption: sessions/catalog/promotion-queue

modelObjects.name: GitHub
modelObjects.description: External host for repositories, pull request events, issue comments, and PR comments. Both advisory agents receive PR webhooks/events from GitHub and post advisory comments back. PRAgent uses GitHub App installation tokens per role agent so agents do not masquerade as a human.
modelObjects.caption: PR events + comments

modelObjects.name: OpenAI
modelObjects.description: External LLM provider. Guardian calls OpenAI directly (from openai import OpenAI; openai_model_analysis default gpt-5) for diff analysis and interview generation. PRAgent's Letta role agents invoke an LLM through Letta for dependency triage, architecture alternatives, synthesis, and evaluator reasoning.
modelObjects.caption: gpt-5 inference

modelObjects.name: Letta
modelObjects.description: External agent runtime hosting PRAgent's bounded role agents with tools, memory, permissions, and hooks. Provides core/archival memory and MemFS, PreToolUse permission hooks (deny_mutation), and tool allowlist/denylist enforcement. The same role-agent identity is reused per repo so memory accumulates by role.
modelObjects.caption: agent runtime + memory

modelObjects.name: Linear
modelObjects.description: Optional external planning and managed policy surface for Guardian. When configured, Linear documents are the canonical policy and Guardian-created issues route policy amendment proposals and drift follow-ups. Guardian still records the exact fetched snapshot for every review.
modelObjects.caption: optional policy + issues

modelObjects.name: frozenSkillz
modelObjects.description: External published skills marketplace (github.com/Coldaine/frozenSkillz) and ~/.agents/skills. Promotion target for reusable cross-project procedures distilled from the learning corpus (e.g. verify-before-claim, retrospective, doppler). Durable product or cluster facts instead promote to project ADRs / docs/history in the governed repos.
modelObjects.caption: promoted skills marketplace
